For Appellant : Mr. R.V.Rajwade, Advocate For Respondent No.3 : Mr. Akash Shrivastava, Advocate

(Single Bench) Hon'ble Shri Justice Sanjay K. Agrawal Order on Board 01.04.2026
1.

Mr. R.V.Rajwade, learned counsel appearing for the claimant, on instructions, seeks to withdraw the instant appeal filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
2.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
Cross objection on behalf of the Insurance Company.
3. Mr. Akash Shrivastava, learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.3/ insurance company would submit that the amount of 79,535/- deserves to be reduced from the amount of compensation.

4. Mr. R.V.Rajwade, learned counsel for the claimant would oppose the submission made by Mr.
Akash Shrivastava, learned counsel for the insurance company.
5. After hearing learned counsel appearing for the parties and going through the record, I do not find it to be a fit case for reduction of the amount of compensation.
Accordingly, the cross-objection filed by the respondent No.3/insurance company is liable to be and accordingly dismissed.

Sd/-
